name: Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher
guide_text: Don't expect much value from this hero power, it's basically Patchwerk 2.0.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up when it costs 3-5. If you can get away with it, hold a powerful spell such as [[Temperature Shift||117670]] to duplicate every turn. You should also try to duplicate and reproc the buddy using [[Lantern Lava]]
